parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese.
*   **en**: English.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the asset. Valid values:

*   **ecs**: Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances.
*   **cloud_product**: cloud services except ECS.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-search-condition --source-ip 117.220.XX.XX --lang zh --type ecs --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas DescribeSearchCondition --region cn-hangzhou --Type ecs --SourceIp '117.220.XX.XX' --Lang zh
